title: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata with KE
question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' (and are not deleted where applicable), list each instance display name along with its average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB, plus the instance VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and the dense-rank window column partitioned by project_id. Also include a formatting column that suppresses repeating display_name values when the same display_name appears in consecutive rows ordered by root_gb_stddev descending. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.display_name,
         i.root_gb,
         i.vm_state,
         i.memory_mb,
         i.project_id,
         iic.network_info
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata m
    ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
   AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
   AND m.deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches iic
    ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
   AND iic.deleted = 0
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
),
agg AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         AVG(root_gb) AS root_gb_avg,
         STDDEV(root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev,
         vm_state,
         memory_mb,
         network_info,
         project_id
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name, vm_state, memory_mb, network_info, project_id
)
SELECT display_name,
       root_gb_avg,
       root_gb_stddev,
       vm_state,
       memory_mb,
       network_info,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC) AS dense_rank,
       CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC) = display_name
            THEN ''
            ELSE display_name
       END AS display_name_fmt
FROM agg
ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC

  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    iic.network_info,
    i.project_id,

    STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev
  FROM instances i

  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    AND ism.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, iic.network_info, i.project_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.project_id ORDER BY b.root_gb) AS dense_rank_project
  FROM base b
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT 
    r.*,
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(r.display_name) OVER (ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC) = r.display_name 
      THEN '' 
      ELSE r.display_name 
    END AS display_name_formatted
  FROM ranked r
)

  f.display_name_formatted AS display_name,
  f.root_gb_avg,
  f.root_gb_stddev,
  f.vm_state,
  f.memory_mb,
  f.network_info,
  f.dense_rank_project
FROM formatted f
